Ring Out - Ver 1.0
Credits, disclaimer and licensing
=================================

DISCLAIMER
----------
This package was put together by Jack Poison, working with AI assistance
(Anthropic's Claude). The AI wrote and debugged a large share of the code
in this port -- the in-game settings overlay, the controller-remapping and
cheat pages, the free-camera wiring, the FMV replacement path, several
static-recompiler codegen fixes, and this packaging -- under Jack Poison's
direction, with testing and decisions made by him.

It is an unofficial fan project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or
connected to any of the projects or companies named below.

No game data or game code is included. You supply a GameCube disc image
that you already have; setup extracts it and recompiles it on your machine.


CREDIT WHERE IT IS DUE
----------------------
Almost none of the heavy lifting here is original. This project is a thin
layer on top of other people's work:

  Dolphin Emulator Project
    The runtime is Dolphin. Graphics, audio, input, savestates, the GameCube
    hardware emulation and the Vulkan backend are all theirs. The settings
    overlay is drawn with Dolphin's existing ImGui integration.
    GPL-2.0-or-later -- https://dolphin-emu.org

  ExpansionPak - ModernGekko
    The chassis that hosts a statically recompiled game inside Dolphin, and
    the StaticRecomp CPU core that hands execution between recompiled code
    and the emulator. https://github.com/ExpansionPak/ModernGekko

  ExpansionPak - DolRecomp
    The static recompiler that translates GameCube PowerPC code into C.
    Included here as tools/dolrecomp so you can build your own module.
    GPL-3.0-or-later -- https://github.com/ExpansionPak/DolRecomp

  Dear ImGui (Omar Cornut and contributors)
    The immediate-mode UI the settings menu is built on. MIT licence.

  FFmpeg
    Used as a separate program to decode the game's Sofdec video, replacing
    the software decoder. Not linked into this binary.

  Bandai Namco Entertainment
    Original game, its code and all its assets. Not included, not
    redistributed, and not ours. All rights remain theirs.

  Cheat codes
    Action Replay codes are published community data (Codejunkies, via
    Almar's Guides). None were written here.

  The r/decomps post that described the recompilation workflow this
  project followed.


LICENCES
--------
  Runtime (Dolphin-derived)  GPL-2.0-or-later
  ModernGekko                GPL
  DolRecomp                  GPL-3.0-or-later
  Dear ImGui                 MIT

The GPL requires that anyone receiving these binaries can get the matching
source. It is in source/ :

  ModernGekko-b79d991ab780.tar.gz          ModernGekko at the built commit
  ModernGekko-dolphin-1873066167f3.tar.gz  the Dolphin tree it vendors
  ModernGekko-dolphin-new-files.tar.gz     new files added by this project
  DolRecomp-2595de599288.tar.gz            the recompiler
  DolRecomp-new-files.tar.gz               its IR and LLVM backend, added here
  *-local-changes.patch                    every modification made here

  Apply the patches to the matching archives, then add the new-files
  archives, to reproduce exactly what these binaries were built from.

If you pass this package on, keep source/ with it.

Anything setup builds from your disc is derived from the game itself.
Keep it to yourself.
